prompt: Is the Brauer–Manin obstruction known to be the only obstruction to the Hasse principle for diagonal quartic surfaces over Q? Check the literature from 2024 onward (arXiv and published) for any new unconditional result, then give the strongest unconditional and conditional results with what each assumes, and one explicit surface where the question is still open.

67-year-old, CKD stage 4 (eGFR 22 mL/min), on apixaban 5 mg twice daily for atrial fibrillation, now diagnosed with invasive pulmonary aspergillosis and starting voriconazole. Propose a dosing and monitoring plan for the next four weeks that handles the CYP3A4 interaction, says when to draw voriconazole troughs and what targets to use, and states the one situation in which you would switch the anticoagulant.

A controller in Ireland uses a processor in the UK that sub-processes in India. Map the transfer mechanism required at each hop under GDPR and UK GDPR today, including the transfer impact assessment expected after Schrems II, and explain exactly which hop breaks and what replaces it if the EU adequacy decision for the UK is not renewed.

Look up the current version of draft-ietf-tls-hybrid-design and its exact key schedule. A hybrid KEM concatenates the ML-KEM-768 and X25519 shared secrets and feeds them to HKDF-SHA256 with both ciphertexts in the info field. (a) State the precise condition under which this combiner stays IND-CCA secure when one component is fully broken, and name the 'dual-PRF' requirement on the KDF. (b) Explain what ML-KEM-768 decapsulation actually does with a malformed or tampered ciphertext: how the FO transform with implicit rejection derives the output from the secret value z and the ciphertext hash instead of returning an error, and why the two-stage check (re-encryption and comparison) must be constant-time. (c) Show how, in this combiner, implicit rejection plus binding the ciphertexts into the KDF info closes the key-mismatch and chosen-ciphertext rejection attacks that an explicit-rejection KEM would expose, and name the one attack it does not close. (d) Say whether the draft's current construction meets all of this, citing the section.

IPE 400 in S355, simply supported 8 m span, no intermediate lateral restraint, end moments giving a linear diagram with ψ = −0.5. Compute Mb,Rd to Eurocode 3 with the general method (6.3.2.2), using the correct C1 for that moment shape, and state whether the simplified method of 6.3.2.3 would be admissible here and what it would give.

Reconstruct the Proto-Indo-European word for 'wheel' from Greek kýklos, Sanskrit cakrá-, Tocharian B kokale and Old English hwēol, explain why the reduplication is original rather than secondary, and say what the Tocharian form tells us that the others cannot.

For a EUR/USD cross-currency basis swap with mark-to-market notional resets on the USD leg, under a USD cash CSA: which curve discounts each leg, how does the valuation differ from the constant-notional swap, and where does the cross-currency basis enter the EUR discount curve construction? Derive it, don't just state it.

Write the Methods section (about 400 words) for a Bayesian chronological model of a stratified Neolithic tell with 42 radiocarbon dates, as a reviewer at Radiocarbon would expect it: calibration curve and its version, marine and freshwater reservoir corrections for the fish-eating individuals, the outlier model you use and why, how the stratigraphic phases enter the model as priors, and how you report agreement indices and a model that fails the threshold.

Five stations recorded a local earthquake. Station (x km, y km): P arrival, S arrival, in seconds after a common reference. A (0, 0): 4.12, 7.31. B (30, 0): 5.90, 10.45. C (0, 40): 6.85, 12.10. D (30, 40): 7.60, 13.42. E (15, 20): 3.95, 7.00. Assume Vp = 6.0 km/s and Vp/Vs = 1.73. Estimate the origin time, epicenter and depth by hand using S-minus-P distances, say which of the four unknowns is worst constrained by this geometry and why, and explain how a 5 % error in Vp/Vs would move your depth estimate.
